Game Overview

In LeapRush, the core idea is straightforward: in LeapRush, guide a playful pup across the sea by leaping between appearing platforms. Master the art of timing and precision in this escalating challenge, where each jump tests your reflexes. Immerse yourself in vibrant seascapes and strive for high scores—can you outpace the clock and reach the finish?
